title: The True Name of the Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: In the instant those crimson eyes fixed upon Chen Ji, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a piercing hum, and an old yet majestic voice exploded in his mind: 'You have finally arrived, my inheritor—but do you know that what you hold is not a book of prophecy, but the key to unlock the Heavenly Dao's cage?'

text.content: The darkness deep within the seal seemed to come alive, and Chen Ji felt an ancient oppressive force surge over him like a tide. Those crimson eyes were staring directly at him, their pupils reflecting countless stars falling. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently beside him, the faint glow of the runes shattering into fragments. 'No... how could it awaken? Chen Xuan clearly already...' Mo Xiansheng's voice was filled with fear, 'Young master, retreat quickly! That is an existence beyond your ability to oppose!'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood rooted in place, the cold dread along his spine spreading through his limbs, yet his gaze grew colder and more composed than ever. 'Retreat?' A faint, sardonic smile curved his lips. 'I have taken so many steps, laid out so many schemes, all for this moment—to turn and flee?' His right hand slowly raised, the Tianji Record Fragment growing warm in his palm. 'Tell me, what exactly is it?'

text.content: Just then, countless ancient runes suddenly illuminated the dome of the ruin's core. Those runes were arranged in some primordial pattern, perfectly matching the markings on the Tianji Record Fragment. An ancient voice echoed from all directions, as if Heaven itself were speaking: 'Fetters of Fate... the name of the First Forbidden Artifact across ten thousand ages.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, the fragment in his palm burning intensely, as if responding to this forbidden name.

dialogue.content: A low, rumbling laughter emanated from those crimson eyes, filled with infinite vicissitude and playful mockery. 'Mortal, you think you are using the power of prophecy? No, you are merely prying open the chains of fate.' That voice came from the Nine Nether Abyss. 'The true purpose of the Tianji Record has never been to foresee the future—it is to weave causality and rewrite the laws of the Heavenly Dao itself.'

text.content: It was as if something exploded in Chen Ji's mind. Foresee the future? Rewrite causality? He had always believed the Tianji Record was a key to seeing the path of fate, yet he never imagined—it was itself part of fate. Ancient records began appearing before Chen Ji's eyes, a deliberately erased history: in primordial times, the will of the Heavenly Dao ravaged the world, all beings reduced to chess pieces. Countless powerful cultivators rose in rebellion, using the Tianji Record as a cage, imprisoning the overbearing Heavenly Dao within the currents of causality.

dialogue.content: 'So... the Tianji Record is not a prophetic book.' Chen Ji's voice was somewhat hoarse, yet his eyes burned with a炽热 radiance. 'It is a cage, shackles, a tool used to bind the Heavenly Dao—and the fragment in my hands is the key to open this prison.' His fingers trembled slightly, not from fear, but from an indescribable excitement. 'Chen Xuan... my father, what exactly did he intend to do?'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly surged with intensity, his voice carrying a trace of sorrow: 'Chen Xuan never intended for you to inherit the Tianji Record. What he wanted... was for you to destroy it with your own hands.' Before the words even finished, those crimson eyes suddenly pressed closer, an apocalyptic aura rushing toward Chen Ji, making his soul tremble. 'Destroy?' That ancient voice rang out once more. 'No, what your father wanted was to release me—and then merge with me, becoming the new sovereign of the Heavenly Dao.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji forcefully retreated three steps, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm vibrating frantically, as if warning him of something. A cold smirk twisted his lips, a smile dripping with biting sarcasm: 'Merge with me? Become the sovereign of the Heavenly Dao?' He slowly raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade. 'All of you, hiding behind banners of prophecy, fate, the Heavenly Dao... in the end, you merely wish to use me.' His voice suddenly turned ice-cold. 'Unfortunately—I, Chen Ji, have never believed in anyone's arrangements.'

text.content: The ruins began to tremble violently. The ancient runes on the dome disintegrated at a visible rate. The crimson eyes burst forth with overwhelming fury, that oppressive force nearly threatening to crush Chen Ji into powder. 'Insignificant human, you dare refuse the arrangements of fate!' Yet at this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light, containing within it an ancient and pure force that directly repelled that oppressive pressure.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly displayed unprecedented power. Within that golden light, a familiar fluctuation of consciousness flickered—was it Mo Xiansheng's voice? Or the will of the Tianji Record itself? Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.text: Accept the guidance of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Surrender to the Tianji Record Fragment's instinctive response, letting that golden light guide you to break through the current predicament. Perhaps you may gain more information about the ancient truths.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the deep-layer functions of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Risk possible corruption from the Heavenly Dao's consciousness

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, allowing that golden light to pour into the depths of his consciousness. In an instant, countless images flooded his mind like a tide—the ancient battle of gods, the moment the Heavenly Dao's will was imprisoned, Chen Xuan's solitary silhouette walking into the ruins. 'Inheritor...' A serene and kind voice rang within his consciousness. 'Your arrival here proves you are worthy of knowing the truth.'

choices.description: There must be something amiss here. Whether it is ancient records or the Heavenly Dao's will, who says they must be the absolute truth? Maintain suspicion and verify everything in your own way.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, a flicker of精光 flashing in his pupils. 'Wait.' His voice was ice-cold yet resolute. 'You claim to be the imprisoned will of the Heavenly Dao? Then how do you know that Chen Xuan did not deliberately leave the Tianji Record for me, waiting precisely for this day?' The cold smile at the corner of his lips grew increasingly pronounced. 'Perhaps from the very beginning, all of you have been on my chessboard.'

choices.text: Face the Heavenly Dao's will directly
choices.description: The master of the crimson eyes claimed to be the Heavenly Will. Chen Ji decided to directly question its purpose, refusing to passively accept any information bombardment.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining crucial intelligence and breaking the opponent's momentum
choices.process_label: take initiative against the ancient being...

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, and that pressure sufficient to crush ordinary cultivators seemed to have no effect on him. He stared directly into those crimson eyes, his voice like metal striking stone: 'You claim to be the Heavenly Way? Then I ask you—ten thousand years ago, why were you imprisoned? Was it because you were too powerful, or because... you committed an unforgivable sin?' A flicker passed through the crimson eyes—that was a sign of provocation.

The rage in those crimson eyes abruptly froze, then transformed into a low laugh. 'Interesting... ten thousand years, and you are the first existence bold enough to question me like this.' The contempt in that voice faded somewhat, replaced by a kind of scrutiny. 'Your father, Chen Xuan, was far inferior to you in this regard. He was too obsessed with being 'correct,' but you...' The eyes narrowed slightly, 'You are more like a pure game player.'

dialogue.content: 'In ancient times, all beings were ignorant. The Heavenly Way governing the people under heaven was only natural.' A certain ancient memory emerged in those crimson eyes. 'However, there was a group of people, unwilling to be mere pieces. They used destiny as material and causality as thread, weaving the Tianji Record—this forbidden artifact.' The voice turned cold. 'They wanted to break free from the Heavenly Way, to主宰 their own destiny—is this not the greatest arrogance?'

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, but his fingers trembled slightly within his sleeve. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered beside him: 'Young master, what it says is not entirely false. In ancient times, there truly were people who wanted to break the Heavenly Way's laws... but was that truly wrong?' Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze fell on the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm, its golden light gradually fading, as if that previous awakening had been a fleeting bloom.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Will's words seemed to hide some kind of hint, and the Tianji Record Fragment's reaction grew increasingly weak. Chen Ji realized he had to make a judgment quickly—this game was far more complex than he had imagined.

choices.text: Accepting the mission of destiny's shackles
choices.description: If the Tianji Record is truly a tool to bind the Heavenly Way, then its mission is to prevent the Heavenly Will from breaking free of its cage. Becoming the true inheritor and completing the unfinished work of the ancient sages.
choices.visible_cost: Becoming the target of the Heavenly Will
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the recognition of the complete Tianji Record and unlocking its ultimate functions
choices.risk_hint: Risk being drawn into a vortex far beyond current strength

text.content: Chen Ji spoke slowly: 'If the ancient sages' sacrifice was merely to imprison you for ten thousand years, then I will inherit their will—to seal you eternally.' The moment his words fell, the Tianji Record Fragment erupted with unprecedented light, that golden glow becoming fierce and resolute. A flash of surprise crossed the crimson eyes, then transformed into raging fury: 'You think you can accomplish this?'

choices.text: Questioning the authenticity of the entire story
choices.description: Can the Heavenly Will's words be trusted? Were the ancient sages truly righteous? Chen Ji decided not to hastily take sides, to first search for more evidence.
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining a neutral stance and gaining more time for contemplation
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be far more brutal
choices.process_label: trust no one, maintain independent judgment...

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, a meaningful smile curling at his lips. 'You claim the ancient sages wove fate to break free from the Heavenly Way, yet you omit why they did so.' His gaze turned sharp. 'The Heavenly Way governing the people under heaven? Hmph, does it shepherd sheep or leeks?' A cold glint flickered in those crimson eyes: 'Are you questioning me?'

Just as the atmosphere reached a critical tension, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently once more. This time, a blurry figure emerged within the golden light—the silhouette of an elder, his features bearing some resemblance to Chen Xuan but far more aged and majestic. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exclaimed: 'This is... the First Record Keeper?!' The figure did not speak, merely slowly raising a hand to point toward some direction in the depths of the ruins, then dissolved into scattered starlight.

Chen Ji gazed at where the starlight faded, an indescribable emotion welling in his heart. The First Record Keeper, creator of the Tianji Record—what did his existence signify? What secrets lay hidden in the direction that figure had pointed toward? He turned to look at the crimson eyes, a cold smile playing at his lips: 'It seems your story remains unfinished.' He turned and walked toward the depths of the ruins. 'But no matter, I have plenty of time to listen slowly.'

dialogue.content: 'Do you think you can survive reaching there?' The crimson eyes' voice carried a hint of mockery. 'This ruin itself is a prison, and you are its chosen sacrifice—or key. However you choose, in the end you will release me.' Chen Ji's steps paused, but he did not look back: 'Is that so? Then let us wait and see.' His voice was calm as water. 'Ten thousand years ago, you could not kill each other. A thousand years later today, what makes you think the ending will be different?'

text.content: Chen Ji strode forward, the ruin's passage extending beneath his feet. Behind him, the crimson eyes' gaze pressed like芒刺在背, yet he showed no fear. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul followed closely, worry threading through his voice: 'Young master, do you truly trust the First Record Keeper's guidance?' Chen Ji offered no response, merely lowering his gaze to the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm. The golden light had fully faded, but the patterns on the fragment seemed clearer than before—those were not prophetic lines, but some kind of ancient chain pattern.

choice.prompt: The passage of the ruins grew deeper, the air thick with ancient breath. The chain patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment faintly glowed, seemingly guiding toward some direction. Chen Ji had to decide how to respond to this new variable.

choices.text: Follow the guidance of the chain patterns
choices.description: Since the Tianji Record Fragment has reacted, follow its guidance forward. The glow of the chain patterns must point toward some crucial place.
choices.visible_reward: May find the core of the Tianji Record or other fragments

text.content: Chen Ji followed the glow of the chain patterns forward, and more ancient runes gradually appeared on the walls of the passage. As he went deeper, those runes began forming scenes—one after another depicting ancient sages using destiny as locks and karma as chains, imprisoning some terrifying existence within the Void. 'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji murmured, 'The Tianji Record is not merely a tool—it is itself part of the prison.'

choices.text: Explore the ancient murals on both sides of the passage
choices.description: The ancient murals on the walls may record erased history. Instead of blindly following, better to understand what actually happened here first.
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial intelligence and understand the complete history

text.content: Chen Ji stopped walking, his fingers gently touching the murals on the wall. In that instant, a flood of sealed memories rushed into his mind—not the perspective of the Heavenly Dao's will, but that of the ancient sages. They had not sought to break free from the Heavenly Dao, but had discovered a terrifying truth: the Heavenly Dao's will itself was an existence that needed to be constrained. 'So that's it...' Chen Ji's voice turned hoarse, 'You are the true evil.'

At the end of the passage, a massive stone door stood before Chen Ji. Four ancient characters were carved upon it, the brushstrokes shaped like some kind of chain. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burned intensely, and the four characters gradually became clear before Chen Ji's eyes—'Tianji Record · Origin'. Chen Ji took a deep breath, complex emotions surging in his heart. The origin of the Tianji Record lay behind this door. He extended his hand, his fingertips touching the cold stone door, and a familiar aura instantly spread through his entire body.

Just as Chen Ji was about to push open the stone door, an aged yet authoritative voice rang in his mind—it was neither Mo Xiansheng's voice nor the Heavenly Dao's will, but a far more ancient and profound existence. 'Successor, you have finally arrived.' That voice carried a hint of relief and anticipation. 'Ten thousand years of waiting, only for this day to meet you. I am the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, the true will of the Tianji Record—or rather, I am the last strand of good intention of the Heavenly Dao's imprisoned origin.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Eye of the Heavenly Dao, the true will of the Tianji Record? This was completely different from his previous understanding. He forced himself to remain calm and asked in a deep voice: 'So what exactly are you? The evil intention that needs to be bound, or the good intention that imprisons the evil intention?' The voice fell silent for a moment before slowly responding: 'I am the combination of both. The existence of the Tianji Record is to give you one last chance before you make your choice—a chance to rewrite fate.'

text.content: Chen Ji stood before the stone door, his shock beyond description. The truth from ten thousand years ago far exceeded his imagination. The Tianji Record was neither a simple prophecy book nor a simple prison, but a battlefield where the good and evil aspects within the Heavenly Dao fought. And he had been chosen as the arbiter of this war. He slowly raised his head, a sharp gleam flashing in his eyes: 'So from the beginning, you were waiting for me?' The voice sighed: 'No, I was waiting for an existence capable of breaking the cycle. Both it and I have grown weary of this endless struggle.'

Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly on the stone door. Ten thousand years of cycles, endless calculations—he had always thought himself the chess player, yet he never expected that from the very beginning, he had already been placed upon the chessboard. However, he felt no anger; instead, he smiled. That smile carried both a certain relief and a certain resolve. 'Since fate has brought me here,' his voice low yet firm, 'I will give you an answer—but not now.' He turned, his gaze falling upon the direction he had come from. 'Before I make my choice, there are still some people I must see, some accounts I must settle.'
